carrier-energy/1.formula: sum over the carrier's generators and t of w_generators[t] x p[t]
carrier-energy/1.validity: every generator of the carrier valid in every snapshot (weights > 0, dispatch within bounds), else invalid_or_missing_generator_data. Refusals: unknown_carrier, ambiguous_carrier, carrier_outside_scope, unsupported_carrier_population

carrier-energy/1.formula: max over t of sum over the carrier's generators of p[t]
carrier-energy/1.validity: every generator of the carrier valid in every snapshot (weights > 0, dispatch within bounds), else invalid_or_missing_generator_data. Refusals: unknown_carrier, ambiguous_carrier, carrier_outside_scope, unsupported_carrier_population

carrier-energy/1.formula: sum over the carrier's StorageUnits of discharged_energy (w_stores x p_dispatch)
carrier-energy/1.validity: every StorageUnit of the carrier passes the storage-unit-dispatch/1 trajectory check, else invalid_or_missing_storage_trajectory. Refusals as for the generator metrics

carrier-energy/1.formula: sum over the carrier's StorageUnits of charged_energy (w_stores x p_store)
carrier-energy/1.validity: every StorageUnit of the carrier passes the storage-unit-dispatch/1 trajectory check, else invalid_or_missing_storage_trajectory. Refusals as for the generator metrics
